```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/tuition.csv"
tuition =read.csv(df_url)|>
  mutate(public_diff=Public.four.year-lag(Public.four.year))
head(tuition)
```

```{r}
acf(na.omit(tuition$public_diff))
pacf(na.omit(tuition$public_diff))
```

```{r}
public_ar=ar(na.omit(tuition$public_diff))
preds=predict(public_ar,n.ahead=10)
predictions=data.frame(
  n=1:10,
  intermediate=preds$pred,
  low= preds$pred-2*preds$se,
  high= preds$pred+2*preds$se
) |>
  pivot_longer(intermediate:high,
               names_to="type",
               values_to="value")

predictions |>
  ggplot(aes(x=n,y=value,col=type)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()
```
